label: Diagram 2.2
caption: Diagram 2.2 Alternative escape routes | Inner rooms
description: This is a plan, labelled in a green band at the bottom as "Diagram 2.2 Alternative escape routes", with the note "See para 2.10" at the top left. The plan shows a room bounded by thick black walls, with a gap in the top wall. Five points are marked with small green squares: A at the top left corner, B at the top wall beside the gap, E at the top right corner, C on the bottom wall, and D on the right wall. Dashed lines run from C to A and from C to B, and from D to A and from D to B. An angle symbol at C, between the dashed lines to A and B, is marked "> 45°". An angle symbol at D, between the dashed lines to A and B, is marked "< 45°". To the right of the plan is running text referring to points C, D and E. No dimensions are given for the walls or the gap.
